ENGINEERING.TITLE: Selected case studies
ENGINEERING.INTRO: Products designed from problem to implementation: clear technical decisions, maintainable architecture, and a focus on real user experience.
ENGINEERING.FORMFLOW_SUMMARY: Dynamic visual web form builder with an interactive canvas, real-time property editor, and landing page preview.
ENGINEERING.FORMFLOW_PROBLEM: I needed a smooth way to edit dynamic structures without coupling the canvas, configuration, and preview to shared logic that would be difficult to evolve.
ENGINEERING.FORMFLOW_ARCHITECTURE: I decoupled form state from canvas rendering with Angular Signals: mutations update the serializable schema, and derived consumers respond only to relevant changes. Dynamic serialization rebuilds fields, properties, and previews without unnecessary re-renders or dependence on a rigid interface.
ENGINEERING.TELEMETRY_SUMMARY: Full-Stack system for ingesting, storing, and visualizing server metrics in real time.
ENGINEERING.TELEMETRY_PROBLEM: Consolidate distributed metrics with consistent validation and a reactive interface that represents changes without coupling UI and persistence.
ENGINEERING.TELEMETRY_ARCHITECTURE: Decoupled NestJS backend with Prisma ORM on PostgreSQL. Strict DTOs validate ingestion events, while RESTful endpoints separate domain contracts from presentation. Angular consumes the API and updates a reactive dashboard with derived state and clear data sources.
